measure_name: Climate-informed policy, regulation and sector standards
definition: Cross-cutting policies, regulations, codes, standards or institutional procedures that address climate resilience, adaptation or emissions reduction for the sector or the project as a whole, and are not about one specific measure. The instrument must apply beyond the assets financed by this project. Includes development or revision of such instruments; completed adoption is not required to identify the intervention. A policy, regulation or standard about one specific measure (energy efficiency standards, e-waste regulation, early-warning protocols, cybersecurity law, tower-siting rules, backup or continuity requirements) belongs to that measure, as do project-specific technical requirements. Excludes generic institutional strengthening, climate aspirations and strategies cited only as context.
boundary: Not a policy, regulation or standard about one specific measure, which belongs to that measure, and not a technical requirement limited to this project, which belongs to the relevant technical measure.
